## RuStore React Native Remote Config SDK for working with the cloud configuration service

### [🔗 Developer Documentation](https://www.rustore.ru/help/en/developers/tools/remote-config)

### Integration into the project

```sh
// HTTPS
npm install git+https://git@gitflic.ru/project/rustore/rustore-react-native-remoteconfig.git

// SSH
npm install git+ssh://git@gitflic.ru/project/rustore/rustore-react-native-remoteconfig.git
```

### Building the example application

You can familiarize yourself with the demo application containing an overview of all SDK methods:
- [README](example/README.en.md)
- [example](https://gitflic.ru/project/rustore/rustore-react-native-remoteconfig/file/?file=example&branch=master)
